propositions: infra exceptions (LLMUnavailableError) at the three gates are handled asymmetrically — plan/code-review gates return degraded INDETERMINATE verdicts while completion gate propagates the exception — and this asymmetry must be preserved
a new dedicated gate_error_v1 schema record must be additively written on infra-exception paths to capture diagnosis start/end windows without changing gate outcomes or verdicts
the ERROR verdict in gate_error_v1 records must not be coerced to FAIL and must not surface via existing verdict readers due to schema-guard filtering

build_error_payload must produce gate_error_v1 records with error.cause and error.evidence_ref fields routed through existing REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT event types without introducing new event types
domain-level BLOCK/FAIL exceptions must not emit gate_error_v1 records — only infrastructure exceptions trigger error sidecar emission
unit tests must verify error record persistence, gate outcome preservation, domain-block exclusion, and schema-guard isolation of ERROR verdicts from existing readers
